Okay, so this one is a slightly more intermediate tutorial, but (like all things) it is so beautiful once you put in the work. You'll need 4 shades of the same color (from light to dark), 1 colored pencil in a similar color (optional), and 1 fine-tip white marker or gel pen. Things to keep in mind: * you'll be working from lightest to darkest * for the wispy, feather-like strokes, hold your markers upright and NOT on an angle (holding upright will give you more a more finer stroke, holding on an angle will produce a broader stroke which isn't what we're going for) * colored pencil is optional but I feel like it ties the look together, feel free to omit if you don't find it necessary. Page: I quickly designed this sheet on Canva, if you want it for free just comment below! I'll send it to you!
